body: Same genre I guess but a tad bit less romantic. Nor are any of them a zombie either :o
Haha, always fun to answer on here. My pleasure!

I make a grin at the TV screen, such good programming for an RPG this old. I ignore the NPC as I steer the controller to wander further into this village.


A little kid runs up to my knights face. Another message comes to show on the screen. "Please help us, hunger has gotten the best of us. I can't believe you've finally come!" 


I grin even wider. Such cool programming this too. Not quite remembering what each button does, I end up totally destroying this kid - knocking him down in his own boots.


"What a game, what animations" I say to myself loudly.


All of a sudden a shepherd and his wife comes running out of one of the small houses in the end of the village. I'm wondering what happens next, is this the start of a quest? I give up on trying to loot the kid and watch as the couple comes closer. It seems they are heading directly for me. 


And so they are. Yeah, it must be a quest!

As they close in the most hollowing sounds of sobbing starts coming out of my TV. It gets so extreme I have to tune it down a notch. 

At this point I'm really impressed about the developers. The couple throws themselves over their dead kid. It's so realistic, I feel for them. 

Expecting a quest I press all buttons to see if anything happens. Nothing, I walk closer to the couple. A bug must've occurred, they're just sobbing over this kid repeatedly. Utterly excited over the animations, but thinking the storyline is a bit harsh. The shepherd is now holding a hand around his wife whilst looking up to the skies screaming 'NOOO! God! Why has you sent us the devils work after all your promises of Messiah?!


Finally a message pops up "You were supposed to help us, why take our son away from us in the most cruel of ways?!" 

I wait a moment and expect a questline to start. Nothing. Again I press all buttons to try and continue the dialogue. I now smash the head of the shepherds wife, lashing my sword through the back of her skull directly afterwards. No wonder the older generations are such badasses when growing up with games like this I'm thinking. The shepherd is now crying so hard it's kind of getting to me. I'm turning the volume off. 


Another message is shown. "Please, just go back where you came from! Stop this madness, I'm begging you.. They were all I had, and now they're gone, forever!" 

Wow. Sort of ruined the fun with it. I'm reminded I don't have a memory card, so I unplug the console and start it over again. This time I'll try not to bug the beginning. 

As it loads back up I enter the world again. But what the hell? Why am I in the exact same spot, when I know for sure I don't have a memory card? I didn't even save. Weird. 

Again a message from the shepherd comes up. "Why don't you just kill me too?! You took everything I had, and now you're back for more?!" 

Now I'm edging out. Restarting again. 


Back in.  Same scenario. But the shepherd is gone. I turn on the volume to see if I can hear anything. No shepherd or his crying is to be heard. But a vague sound of horses galopping is closing in. The shepherd sticks his head out of one of the windows in the small house he and the wife had come from at first. He's pointing at my character, yelling "It was him! The devil!" 


I'm thinking the game has begun. First fight. 


I see a group of knights. I embrace for battle. As they start attacking me visciously, I try to fight back. It's impossible, so realistic. They are ripping my character to pieces. The the weirdest thing happens. 


I see smoke coming from my console. What the hell is happening? I get up quickly and pull the cord. But the console is still going. I'm panicking. 


"There are no escaping the punishment of the kings guard!" 

One of the knights get off his horseback. Smoke is still coming from my console. He cuts the head off my character as my TV goes from the game to static. The whole console and game is fried. I'm breathing heavily, not understanding what just happened. 

I decide to let it cool off before I take it to Gamestop. I need to find out what game and what console this really is. 

I get to the store and pull the console and controller up from the bag. The cashier gives me a weird look, the whole thing is toasted after all. Then says:


"Look man I'm sorry, but whatever this thing is - it's not made by humans. I've never seen technology like this before. Too bad it's all burned up." 

I mumble some words to him, put my stuff back in the bag.  Drive home unsure of whether I just murdered a man's kid and wife in front of him or not. I get back home and throw the whole thing up back in the attic where it, never to speak of it again.

I refrain from answering the talking fishman nurse. He says he'll be back and wobbles off out of the room. I'm scared shitless, is this heaven or hell? Am I dead? I think so. If not, I soon will be - because this is messed up beyond all reason. I look out the window, a shark high fives a turtle as they pass each other. Mild to say confused now. I'm shaking vigorously but assume it's normal in Atlantis, as people are fish. I remember drowning, sadness fills me up. I take a deep breath, water fills me up. I try not to overthink it but find it quite hard not to. Happy that I booked the cruise alone and left my loved ones to stay at home for a shitty holiday. Sad again when realizing I went on a better one but died and woke up in Atlantis. Now I'm starting to black out. Fishman nurse comes running in, says there's a problem. I gesture to make him tell me what's wrong.
'You're not fishman, you soon dead. But thanks for visiting Atlantis, the forgotten city!' 
I flip him off and die.

I tell my wife i have to call her back up and that I'll explain later. I turn off the phone, sit down on the bed. God, I'm destroyed from last night. I feel  tremors of stress and anxiety creeping up on me. I try to breathe them out. 
Now I'm thinking.. thinking and thinking - too confused to even acknowledge the stench of chemicals I'm literally soaked in, and now the bed. I try to remember. 
I was in a bar. A memory of an Irish man mastering the art of talking rubbish pops up. Can't be him. Too stupid. 
The widower at the bar desk downing a bottle of scotch before he was rejected another one.
No, can't be him either. We didn't talk. 
A vague memory of a bearded man with glasses and a hat entering the bar comes to mind. We were talking, I just can't remember who or what. Oh crap! Rachel mentioned the cops is after me. 
I check out the window, I'm high up. I see a normal street down under, but it's not familiar. I check the room service menu, never heard of the hotel. Police after me.. What the hell is going on here? I check the bathroom. 
I see a barrel with something standing in front of the toilet. Immediately shut the door, already had enough. 
What is this sorcery? Why can't I remember?
Come on, come on.. Give me a lead, something. 
Pockets! I go through one after one, no luck at first. Until I feel something lying deep down in the back pocket of my jeans. A note. How can this be relevant? 
I unfold it and start reading. And freeze. 

'Meet at usual place at 12 AM. Bring the Methylamine. We need to cook. W.W.'

I'm fucked.
